services.name: Pottery Kiln
services.desc: The Silver River Museum wood-fired pottery kiln is a “manabigama” design and is one of the only kilns like it in Florida. Traditional folk pottery forms such as bowls, crocks and jugs are made by resident potter Deborah Sands. Construction was completed in 2017 and the kiln is fired an average of six times per year
